matched_cohort.desc: 140 accrual-terminated vs 140 completed, matched on condition+phase. Removes base-rate confounds; isolates design-intrinsic signal.
matched_cohort.note_C0: Base rate carries no within-pair signal by construction (matched design) — AUC≈0.50. This is why the matched test is the hard one.
matched_cohort.C1_method: Nested 5-fold CV (10 seeds): ensemble weight alpha chosen on inner training folds only, evaluated on held-out outer folds. No eval-set tuning.

natural_distribution.desc: 927 trials at natural 19% accrual-failure prevalence, v0-only, ESTIMATED enrollment only (leak-free). Reflects deployment reality.
